填空題：M I _ R _ T _ O N (動物季節性或定期遷移的行為)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 各方有公平競爭條件
B. 只能在平坦草地比賽
C. 所有參賽者實力相同
D. 比賽必須以平手結束
normal.explain: 比喻公平條件，不保證實力或結果相等。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 已正式退出所屬球隊
B. 因久未練習而生疏
C. 練習量多到過度疲勞
D. 正在場外觀看練習
normal.explain: out of practice 指技巧生疏，不等於退隊。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 決定不再嘗試
B. 等別人替自己完成
C. 逐漸掌握做法
D. 把東西掛到架上
normal.explain: get the hang of 是掌握操作或技巧。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 在場地轉彎
B. 輪流進行
C. 一起同時開始
D. 改變活動方向
normal.explain: take turns 是輪替，不是一起做。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: You do not need to be fast, but you do need to be comfortable cycling for an hour.
options: A. 只要騎得快就不必騎滿時段。
B. 活動只有一小時的騎車教學。
C. 不用騎得快，但需能自在騎一小時。
D. 必須以最快速度騎完一小時。
normal.explain: 速度非條件，持續騎乘的適應程度才是條件。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We lost on points, though we won more individual games than they did.
options: A. 我們總分較高，但贏的場次較少。
B. 雙方總分與勝場都一樣。
C. 比賽只有一場而我們輸了。
D. 我們總分輸了，儘管贏的個別場次較多。
normal.explain: 總分與勝場數是不同計分層次。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The booking is for the court, not for a lesson, so nobody will be there to coach us.
options: A. 只有教練能用我們預約的場地。
B. 教練已取消原本包含的課程。
C. 預約的是場地而非課程，所以不會有教練教我們。
D. 預約包括場地和一堂教練課。
normal.explain: not for a lesson 說明原安排，非臨時取消。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: She makes it look easy, which is probably why people underestimate how much practice goes into it.
options: A. 她不用練習，所以表現總是輕鬆。
B. 旁人認為她練太多而影響表現。
C. 她刻意讓技巧看起來比實際更難。
D. 她做得看似輕鬆，可能使人低估背後練習量。
normal.explain: 表現自然不等於不需練習；probably 保留推測。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would not call it cheating, but I can see why the others felt it went against the spirit of the game.
options: A. 我不會稱為作弊，但理解其他人為何覺得違背遊戲精神。
B. 我確認對方違反明文規則，理應受罰。
C. 我認為其他人已接受這種做法。
D. 我無法理解其他人為何在意此事。
normal.explain: 區分明文作弊定性與精神層面的不滿。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】Which expression means to stop playing fairly because the result seems impossible to change? The team must not ___ before the final whistle.
options: A. give up
B. warm up
C. turn up
D. sign up
normal.explain: give up 放棄；warm up 暖身、turn up 出現、sign up 報名。

normal.desc: 【文法】You can borrow a racket as long as you ___ it before closing time.
options: A. have return
B. return
C. will returning
D. returned it
normal.explain: as long as 表條件，談未來用現在式 return。

normal.desc: 【語意】The club welcomes beginners but asks players to bring their own shoes. What is provided by this statement?
options: A. A restriction to experienced competitors.
B. A requirement to buy shoes from the club.
C. An invitation with a practical requirement.
D. A promise to lend all necessary clothing.
normal.explain: 歡迎初學者並不取消自備鞋子的要求，也未限定購買處。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which adjective means decided beforehand rather than arranged at the last moment?
options: A. improvised
B. prearranged
C. unplanned
D. spontaneous
normal.explain: prearranged 指預先安排；其他詞表示未先規劃。

normal.desc: 【短文】A club charges an entry fee but lends equipment at no extra cost. A visitor assumes that borrowing a racket makes the whole visit free. What has been confused?
options: A. The right to borrow with the right to buy.
B. The opening time with the booking period.
C. The cost of equipment with the cost of entry.
D. The entry charge with a refundable deposit.
normal.explain: 器材免加價不等於入場免費。

normal.desc: 【文法】If I had known the session was outdoors, I ___ a warmer jacket.
options: A. will have brought
B. had bringing
C. would bring yesterday
D. would have brought
normal.explain: 對過去未實現條件，用 if had known / would have brought。

normal.desc: 【短文】A competition ranks teams by points. If points are equal, fewer penalties decides the order. Two teams have equal points, but one has fewer penalties. Which rule applies?
options: A. Ignore penalties because the points are equal.
B. Ask which team joined the competition first.
C. Use the penalty count to break the tie.
D. Award extra points for the lower penalty count.
normal.explain: 題幹給同分排序規則；不是改寫得分。

normal.desc: 【語用】I am happy to take part, provided nobody expects me to keep up with the regular runners. What is the speaker doing?
options: A. Declining until the regular runners leave the club.
B. Promising to match the fastest regular runner.
C. Asking the club to stop recording everyone’s times.
D. Agreeing while setting a limit on expectations.
normal.explain: 同意參與但要求調整對自身表現的期待。

normal.desc: 【短文】The organisers say the event is not a race, yet display everyone’s finishing order on a large screen. Some participants feel competitive pressure. What explains their reaction?
options: A. The public comparison may conflict with the stated emphasis on participation.
B. The organisers have announced that slower participants cannot return.
C. The participants have misunderstood the difference between screens and clocks.
D. The event must have awarded cash prizes according to finishing order.
normal.explain: 公開排名可產生競爭壓力，不必已有獎金或淘汰規則。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：競賽中公平尊重他人的運動精神
請唸出單字：持續進行體力或心力活動的耐力
請唸出：彼此友善但有競爭的關係
請唸出：兼顧雙方的公平折衷
請唸出：公平結果不必是相等結果
normal.ans: A FAIR RESULT NEED NOT BE AN EQUAL RESULT
normal.speak: a fair result need not be an equal result
normal.vocabId: R6:A FAIR RESULT NEED NOT BE AN EQUAL RESULT

normal.desc: 請唸出：定期練習能讓難技巧看似容易
normal.ans: REGULAR PRACTICE CAN MAKE A DIFFICULT SKILL LOOK EASY
normal.speak: regular practice can make a difficult skill look easy
normal.vocabId: R6:REGULAR PRACTICE CAN MAKE A DIFFICULT SKILL LOOK EASY

normal.desc: 請拼出：用來擊球的球拍（R 開頭，6 個字母；字數依主要拼字，亦接受標準變體）
請拼出：由多場比賽組成的錦標賽（T 開頭，10 個字母）
請拼出：使身體動作配合的協調能力（C 開頭，12 個字母）
填空題：U M P _ R E (某些運動中執行規則的裁判)
填空題：S P E _ T A _ O R (觀看活動或比賽的觀眾)
填空題：F _ X _ U _ E (預定舉行的一場體育賽事)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 必須逐字公開播出的內容
B. 不供公開引用或報導
C. 已正式列入公開紀錄
D. 因錄音結束而停止說話
normal.explain: off the record 是消息使用條件，不只錄音開關狀態。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 估算紙張印刷所需的價格
B. 核對說話者的臉部照片
C. 依表面意思接受而不多作懷疑
D. 從未明說的地方推敲隱意
normal.explain: take at face value 指照表面價值或意思接受。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 把錄音檔排成直線
B. 刪掉所有原始紀錄
C. 正式結束一場比賽
D. 澄清已被誤解的事實
normal.explain: put the record straight 指釐清事實。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 由兩種語言組成的每一則訊息
B. 因檔案格式不同而不能開啟的信
C. 傳達彼此不一致暗示的訊息
D. 同時寄給不同人的同一封信
normal.explain: mixed message 核心是訊號或立場不一致，不是混合語言。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I meant to warn you that the time might change, not tell you that the event had been cancelled.
options: A. 我已宣布活動取消，只是尚未決定退款時間。
B. 活動時間確定不變，只有場地可能更換。
C. 我原想取消活動，但現在決定照常舉行。
D. 我想提醒時間可能變，不是說活動已取消。
normal.explain: 區分可能改期與已取消，兩者確定度與內容不同。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The quotation is accurate as far as it goes, but the next sentence changes how I would understand it.
options: A. 引文所引部分正確，但下一句會改變我對它的理解。
B. 引文有字詞錯誤，下一句則逐字正確。
C. 下一句已證明被引述的人沒有說過這些話。
D. 引文和下一句完全無關，只是格式不同。
normal.explain: 字面引用正確仍可能脈絡不足。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The update confirms the venue, but we are still waiting for a definite starting time.
options: A. 更新已確認時間，地點則仍在商議。
B. 更新宣布時間地點一律依原訂安排。
C. 地點已取消，時間則由參加者自行選擇。
D. 更新確認了地點，但確定開始時間仍待通知。
normal.explain: 確認事項僅場地，時間未定。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I would not assume she agrees just because she has not replied; she may not have seen the message.
options: A. 別因她未回覆就認定同意，她可能沒看見訊息。
B. 她未回覆已表明反對，只是不好意思直說。
C. 她已看過訊息，所以沉默必定表示同意。
D. 說話者確認她看過後決定不再參加。
normal.explain: 提出未讀作替代解釋，沒有斷言她必定未讀。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: It sounds more definite in the summary than it did when he actually said it.
options: A. 原話與摘要用相同措辭表達同等確定度。
B. 摘要的語氣比他原本說話更確定。
C. 原話比摘要更堅定，摘要加入太多保留。
D. 摘要新增的細節已使原話得到證實。
normal.explain: 比較表達確定度，不是判斷內容真假已定。

normal.desc: 【文法】The presenter said that the interview ___ the previous evening.
options: A. was been recorded
B. had been recorded
C. has been recording
D. will record
normal.explain: 轉述中 the previous evening 指過去另一事件前，用過去完成式被動。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which verb means to publicly withdraw a statement because it is no longer supported?
options: A. illustrate
B. circulate
C. retract
D. repeat
normal.explain: retract 是撤回聲明；repeat 重複、illustrate 說明、circulate 流傳。

normal.desc: 【語意】The editor asks for a brief account of the meeting. What is requested?
options: A. A detailed record of every spoken word.
B. A prediction of what the next meeting will decide.
C. A list of people who refused to attend.
D. A concise description of what happened.
normal.explain: brief account 是簡短敘述，不是逐字稿或未來預測。

normal.desc: 【範圍】A notice says the service may be interrupted on Friday. Which paraphrase preserves its certainty?
options: A. The service will stop for the whole of Friday.
B. The service has already stopped this Friday.
C. An interruption is possible on Friday.
D. An interruption is scheduled for every Friday.
normal.explain: may 是可能，未說必然、整天或每週。

normal.desc: 【短文】A headline says a proposal has been approved. The article says only that a committee has agreed to discuss it. What needs correcting?
options: A. The committee has been presented as a single person.
B. A completed discussion has been presented as a future one.
C. The proposal has been presented as already rejected.
D. Discussion has been presented as approval.
normal.explain: agree to discuss 不等於 approve，標題提高決策進度。

normal.desc: 【文法】The email was so badly worded that I could not tell ___ the request was urgent.
options: A. whether
B. which
C. whose
D. unless
normal.explain: tell whether ... 表辨別是否；urgent 是待判定狀態。

normal.desc: 【短文】A photograph shows a crowded hall, but its caption gives neither the event nor the date. A reader uses it to support a claim about yesterday’s meeting. What is missing?
options: A. Evidence that a hall can accommodate a crowd.
B. A count of the chairs visible in the background.
C. The names of everyone who attended yesterday.
D. Confirmation that the photograph depicts that meeting.
normal.explain: 需先確認照片對應所稱事件；其他資訊非此關鍵。

normal.desc: 【語用】I can see why you read it that way, though I am not sure that is what she intended. What is the speaker doing?
options: A. Acknowledging a reading while questioning the intended meaning.
B. Accepting that the writer deliberately chose to offend the reader.
C. Denying that the reader could reasonably interpret the words that way.
D. Asking the writer to use exactly the same words in a new message.
normal.explain: 理解讀者解讀有由，不代表確定作者意圖如此。

normal.desc: 【短文】A presenter calls a clip unedited. The clip is continuous, but begins after the speaker has explained the condition attached to an offer. What distinction matters?
options: A. An unedited extract is necessarily longer than the original.
B. An uninterrupted extract may still omit relevant context.
C. A continuous extract must show a different speaker.
D. An omitted condition proves the offer was withdrawn.
normal.explain: 片段內未剪接不等於包含前後全部脈絡。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：為圖片提供說明的文字
請唸出單字：正式撤回先前聲明的行動
請唸出：容易使人誤解內容的標題
請唸出：理解內容所需的完整脈絡
請唸出：禮貌回覆不一定表示同意
normal.ans: A POLITE REPLY DOES NOT NECESSARILY EXPRESS AGREEMENT
normal.speak: a polite reply does not necessarily express agreement
normal.vocabId: R6:A POLITE REPLY DOES NOT NECESSARILY EXPRESS AGREEMENT

normal.desc: 請唸出：摘要聽起來比原文確定
normal.ans: THE SUMMARY SOUNDS MORE DEFINITE THAN THE ORIGINAL
normal.speak: the summary sounds more definite than the original
normal.vocabId: R6:THE SUMMARY SOUNDS MORE DEFINITE THAN THE ORIGINAL

normal.desc: 請拼出：正式撤回先前說法（R 開頭，7 個字母）
請拼出：向大眾播送的節目（B 開頭，9 個字母）
請拼出：避免明確表態或承諾的（N 開頭，12 個字母）
填空題：R U M _ U R (流傳但未獲證實的說法)
填空題：T R A _ S C _ I P T (將口頭內容寫下的逐字紀錄)
填空題：P U _ L _ C _ T Y (使人或事受到大眾注意的宣傳)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 把房子改建成新樣式
B. 獨自負擔全部家務
C. 像在自己家般自在
D. 立刻返回自己的住處
normal.explain: 招待客人時意為放輕鬆自在。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 專門進行裝修的房間
B. 已達到不需修改的程度
C. 因房間太大而無法維護
D. 仍有可以改善之處
normal.explain: room 比喻空間或餘地，不必是實體房間。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 暫時解決問題的辦法
B. 一次完成的永久翻新
C. 固定不再更動的規則
D. 仍未開始討論的計畫
normal.explain: temporary fix 緩解眼前問題，不保證長久處理。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 共用一把遮雨傘
B. 屋頂只能使用一種材料
C. 所有人都睡同一張床
D. 住在或位於同一建築內
normal.explain: under one roof 指同一屋簷下，不必同房。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We can move the desk, but I would check that the door still opens fully before settling on that corner.
options: A. 可搬桌子，但選定那個角落前我會確認門能全開。
B. 桌子已搬好，所以門現在確定能全開。
C. 說話者主張不管門是否受阻都用那個角落。
D. 說話者要求拆門之後才能討論搬桌子。
normal.explain: 建議先檢查空間相容性，非已確認結果或施工要求。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I agreed to look after the plants while you were away, not to reorganise the whole balcony.
options: A. 我已把植物重新擺好，只剩陽台地板。
B. 我答應你不在時照顧植物，不是重整整個陽台。
C. 我答應重整陽台，但沒有答應碰植物。
D. 我原本拒絕幫忙，現在才同意照顧植物。
normal.explain: 區分同意任務的範圍。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The repair looks neat, though we have not yet had enough rain to see whether it has solved the leak.
options: A. 修補外觀看來整齊，但雨還不夠多，未能驗證是否止漏。
B. 修補已經歷大雨，因此確認完全不漏。
C. 修補因外觀不整齊而被確定無效。
D. 只要外觀整齊，就不必再看下雨情況。
normal.explain: 外觀品質與功能驗證不同，未提供施工建議。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: It is not the mess itself that bothers me so much as never knowing who is expected to deal with it.
options: A. 我已決定只要不是自己整理就不再介意。
B. 比起凌亂本身，更困擾我的是不知該由誰處理。
C. 最困擾我的是東西多，責任分配倒很清楚。
D. 我不在意由誰處理，只要求立刻購買新收納櫃。
normal.explain: not ... so much as ... 比較困擾來源，重點在責任不明。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The room feels more spacious now, even though we have actually added a small table.
options: A. 多放桌子使房間比以前更擁擠。
B. 房間只是看來更大，家具其實全移除了。
C. 房間現在感覺更寬敞，儘管實際多放一張小桌。
D. 房間擴建後才有空間放原來那張大桌。
normal.explain: 空間感與家具件數不必反向連動，未說擴建。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】Which expression means to delay starting a task? We cannot ___ cleaning the storeroom any longer.
options: A. set up
B. take over
C. put off
D. clear out
normal.explain: put off 延後；clear out 清空、set up 設立、take over 接手。

normal.desc: 【文法】I would rather you ___ before moving my things next time.
options: A. will ask
B. have asking
C. to ask
D. asked
normal.explain: would rather + 不同主詞 + 過去式，表對現在或未來的偏好。

normal.desc: 【語意】The room is compact rather than cramped. What is the intended positive distinction?
options: A. It is small but does not feel uncomfortably crowded.
B. It is large but has been filled with too much furniture.
C. It is small because it has not yet been decorated.
D. It is crowded but easier to heat than a larger room.
normal.explain: compact 緊湊可含正面意味；cramped 是擁擠侷促。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which adjective describes a surface that is not level or smooth?
options: A. upright
B. unoccupied
C. waterproof
D. uneven
normal.explain: uneven 不平整；upright 直立、unoccupied 無人用、waterproof 防水。

normal.desc: 【短文】A notice asks residents not to leave bicycles in the hallway, but provides a rack in the courtyard. A resident says bicycles have been banned from the building’s grounds. What is overstated?
options: A. A location-specific restriction has become a general ban.
B. An optional storage suggestion has become a required purchase.
C. A rule about bicycles has become a rule about cars.
D. A temporary closure has become a permanent repair.
normal.explain: 走廊禁放不等於全院禁止，另有停車架。

normal.desc: 【文法】The cupboard needs ___, but we can leave the painting until later.
options: A. repair itself
B. repairing
C. to repairing
D. have repaired
normal.explain: need doing 表某物需要被處理，cupboard needs repairing。

normal.desc: 【短文】One housemate agrees to clean the kitchen if another clears the table first. The table remains covered. What is the most accurate description?
options: A. The condition attached to the cleaning agreement has not been met.
B. The housemate has refused to do any cleaning under any circumstances.
C. The table must be cleared only after the kitchen has been cleaned.
D. The agreement gives the second housemate responsibility for every room.
normal.explain: if ... first 設先行條件，不是無條件拒絕清潔。

normal.desc: 【語用】I do not mind the music, just not at a volume that fills every room. What is being challenged?
options: A. The use of speakers rather than headphones specifically.
B. Its loudness rather than its presence.
C. Its musical style rather than its loudness.
D. The time it starts rather than the room it fills.
normal.explain: 不反對音樂本身，只反對音量影響全部房間；未限定器材。

normal.desc: 【短文】A flat is described as newly decorated. The visitor notices freshly painted walls but worn plumbing fittings. Which conclusion is warranted?
options: A. The worn fittings establish that none of the walls has been repainted.
B. The visitor has proved that the flat has never undergone any maintenance.
C. The description does not by itself establish that every fitting has been replaced.
D. The description guarantees that all hidden systems have been renewed.
normal.explain: 裝飾翻新不等於所有設備更換；不推論隱藏系統狀態。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：凌亂堆放而使空間擁擠的物品
請唸出單字：使建物或物品維持良好狀態的保養
請唸出：由多人共同承擔的責任
請唸出：令人高興的改變
請唸出：整齊外觀不證明修補有效
normal.ans: A TIDY APPEARANCE DOES NOT PROVE THE REPAIR WORKS
normal.speak: a tidy appearance does not prove the repair works
normal.vocabId: R6:A TIDY APPEARANCE DOES NOT PROVE THE REPAIR WORKS

normal.desc: 請唸出：搬東西前應先同意改動
normal.ans: WE SHOULD AGREE ON CHANGES BEFORE MOVING THINGS
normal.speak: we should agree on changes before moving things
normal.vocabId: R6:WE SHOULD AGREE ON CHANGES BEFORE MOVING THINGS

normal.desc: 請拼出：維持設備建物良好狀態的保養（M 開頭，11 個字母）
請拼出：有門的收納櫃（C 開頭，8 個字母）

填空題：F U R N I _ H I N G (家具或窗簾等室內擺設物)
填空題：T H R _ S H _ L D (門口下方跨過的門檻)
填空題：W _ R _ T _ P (廚房等供作業使用的檯面)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 把工具正式借給別人
B. 要求別人接手全部工作
C. 把責任轉交而不再參與
D. 幫忙出一份力
normal.explain: lend a hand 是提供協助。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 隨時準備在需要時接手
B. 已確定不再提供任何服務
C. 站在固定位置等待拍照
D. 正式接任全部工作直到結束
normal.explain: on standby 是待命可用，不等於已接手。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 在預訂截止前的最後一天
B. 在活動舉行當天
C. 在公告發出的那一天固定時刻
D. 在任何白天而非夜晚
normal.explain: 活動語境的 on the day 通常指活動當天。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 大約的人數統計
B. 只計算主辦人而排除來賓
C. 已逐一核對身份的精確名單
D. 以身高排序而成的隊伍
normal.explain: rough 表大略；headcount 人數。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: We have enough people to open the stalls, but not enough to keep every stall open all afternoon.
options: A. 人數充足，所以每人都可以提早離開。
B. 人手足以開攤，但不足以讓每攤整個下午都開。
C. 每攤整個下午都有人，但無人負責開場。
D. 所有攤位已因人手不足取消。
normal.explain: 開始營運與持續覆蓋是不同人力要求。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I can cover the first hour if someone takes over at eleven, because I cannot stay any later.
options: A. 即使沒人接手，我也能留下直到活動結束。
B. 我已安排好十一點的接手人，無需再找。
C. 若十一點有人接手，我能顧第一小時，之後不能留。
D. 我會從十一點起接手，但只做最後一小時。
normal.explain: 條件是有人接班，未說已找到接班者。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The room is booked until five, which means we need to finish clearing up by then, not just finish the talk.
options: A. 房間已續訂，所以演講可以晚些結束。
B. 房間訂到五點，代表收拾也要在那時完成。
C. 演講五點開始，收拾時間則另外計算。
D. 只要演講五點結束，收拾多久都不限。
normal.explain: by then 的範圍包括清場，不只節目。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I am glad everyone is willing to help; I would be even happier if we knew which jobs each person had actually agreed to do.
options: A. 說話者認為願意幫忙就表示同意所有任務。
B. 說話者不信任任何人，因而取消全部分工。
C. 很高興大家肯幫忙，但更希望清楚每人已同意的工作。
D. 大家已分工清楚，所以現在只需再招更多人。
normal.explain: 肯定意願並指出任務承諾尚不明確。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The plan works if the weather stays dry, so we should not describe it as settled until we have an alternative.
options: A. 乾天方案已定，因此備案只需活動後再想。
B. 說話者確認天氣預報保證整天不下雨。
C. 備案必須與乾天方案內容完全一致。
D. 乾天才可行，沒有備案前不宜說計畫已定。
normal.explain: 有條件可行與整體準備完備不同。

normal.desc: 【搭配詞】Which expression means to take responsibility for a task? Could you ___ checking the guest list?
options: A. make up for
B. put up with
C. look back on
D. take charge of
normal.explain: take charge of 是負責；其餘為彌補、忍受、回顧。

normal.desc: 【文法】Please let us know by Thursday whether you ___ to attend on Saturday.
options: A. will be able
B. were being able
C. have able
D. will can
normal.explain: 未來能否出席用 will be able to；can 不能與 will 並用。

normal.desc: 【語意】Volunteers may choose a morning or afternoon shift, but not both. What is offered?
options: A. A guarantee that both periods have equal workloads.
B. A choice between two periods of duty.
C. Permission to split each shift into two halves.
D. A requirement to work throughout the whole day.
normal.explain: or ... but not both 明示二擇一，不保證工作量相同。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which noun refers to a person who is present at an event?
options: A. attendee
B. applicant
C. organiser
D. nominee
normal.explain: attendee 是出席者；其他為申請者、主辦者、被提名者。

normal.desc: 【短文】An invitation asks guests to reply even if they cannot attend. A guest says silence will be understood as a refusal. What has the guest overlooked?
options: A. The invitation gives a different reply deadline to each guest.
B. The request includes people who will not attend.
C. The event requires every invitee to bring another guest.
D. The organisers have already assumed everyone will attend.
normal.explain: even if cannot attend 仍須回覆，不應以沉默代替。

normal.desc: 【文法】We will have the chairs ___ before the doors open.
options: A. to arranging
B. arrange them
C. arranged
D. arranging
normal.explain: have + 受詞 + 過去分詞 表安排某物被處理；chairs 被排好。

normal.desc: 【短文】A volunteer offers to distribute leaflets, not design them. The organiser later criticises her for failing to produce a layout. What should be checked?
options: A. Whether distribution must always follow the same route.
B. Whether the expected task matches the task she accepted.
C. Whether leaflets are usually printed in colour.
D. Whether more than one person may attend the event.
normal.explain: 分發與設計是不同任務，需核對承諾範圍。

normal.desc: 【語用】That should be manageable, as long as the numbers do not change again. How firm is the agreement?
options: A. It confirms that further changes have already been approved.
B. It guarantees success even if attendance rises sharply.
C. It is positive but depends on the numbers remaining stable.
D. It is a refusal to manage the event regardless of numbers.
normal.explain: should 與 as long as 合成有條件的可行評估。

normal.desc: 【短文】A workshop has ten places. The organiser keeps two for people unable to book online. A website shows eight bookable places. A visitor calls this evidence that two places have already been sold. What is missing?
options: A. The total capacity must exclude all visitors who use the website.
B. The workshop has promised to increase capacity by two places.
C. The organiser has withdrawn the two places from the event entirely.
D. Not all unavailable places represent completed bookings.
normal.explain: 保留名額與已售出不同；題幹已給保留原因。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：列出人員與工作安排的名單
請唸出單字：可能發生而需要預作準備的情況
請唸出：能力範圍內可應付的工作量
請唸出：仍可能調整的暫定時程
請唸出：願幫忙的志工未同意所有任務
normal.ans: A WILLING VOLUNTEER HAS NOT AGREED TO EVERY TASK
normal.speak: a willing volunteer has not agreed to every task
normal.vocabId: R6:A WILLING VOLUNTEER HAS NOT AGREED TO EVERY TASK

normal.desc: 請唸出：預訂時段包含所需清場時間
normal.ans: THE BOOKING PERIOD INCLUDES THE TIME NEEDED FOR CLEARING UP
normal.speak: the booking period includes the time needed for clearing up
normal.vocabId: R6:THE BOOKING PERIOD INCLUDES THE TIME NEEDED FOR CLEARING UP

normal.desc: 請拼出：活動的出席者（A 開頭，8 個字母）
請拼出：把工作或權限委派他人（D 開頭，8 個字母）
請拼出：償還他人已代墊的費用（R 開頭，9 個字母）
填空題：B A _ G E (表示身份或角色的小牌子)
填空題：V _ N _ E (活動舉行的場地)
填空題：R E G _ S T _ A T _ O N (登記參加的程序)
🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 回想過往的懷舊經驗
B. 實際沿著名為記憶的小路散步
C. 對未來旅行作詳細預測
D. 完全忘記曾經到過的地方
normal.explain: 此慣用語指重溫往事。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 標示哪裡可以購買衣物
B. 出現使用磨損的痕跡
C. 展示穿衣服的操作步驟
D. 被確認從未使用過
normal.explain: wear 作名詞可指磨損。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
options: A. 已失去原有形狀
B. 只剩下零散配件
C. 保存完好而幾乎如新
D. 帶有薄荷味道
normal.explain: mint condition 指狀態近全新，不是氣味。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The original is kept upstairs; this is the copy visitors are allowed to handle.
options: A. 複本已遺失，所以改讓遊客觸摸原件。
B. 原件放樓上，這是讓遊客觸摸的複本。
C. 這是原件，樓上的複本禁止觸摸。
D. 遊客可把樓上原件帶走，複本則留此處。
normal.explain: 區分展示用複本與原件的存放用途。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I had remembered the room as enormous, but of course I was only six the last time I saw it.
options: A. 說話者六年前才來，因此記憶必然完全準確。
B. 說話者已忘記房間，無法描述任何印象。
C. 我記得房間很大，不過上次看見時我才六歲。
D. 房間已被確定擴建，所以現在比記憶大。
normal.explain: 年齡視角可能影響大小記憶，未明說物理改建。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The date on the frame tells us when it was presented, not necessarily when the picture was painted.
options: A. 框上日期已確定是畫作與框都製成的同一天。
B. 畫作年代比贈送日期晚，所以日期必定偽造。
C. 日期只說明照片沖洗時間，與贈送無關。
D. 框上的日期是贈送時間，不一定是畫作完成時間。
normal.explain: 同一物件可有不同相關日期，不能直接互代。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: Please do not straighten the bent handle; the bend is part of the story we are trying to preserve.
options: A. 故事證明把手本來就是直的，彎曲是誤會。
B. 說話者只反對拍攝把手，並未談修整。
C. 別把彎把手弄直，那彎曲是我們想保留的故事一部分。
D. 把手已被矯直，所以需要重新弄彎。
normal.explain: 保存使用痕跡而非只追求整齊，非實際維修建議。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: I know it is not rare, but rarity is not really the point when it is the one I remember from our kitchen.
options: A. 它必定非常稀有，所以我才記得家裡有它。
B. 只要新物件更罕見，就能完全取代原有回憶。
C. 說話者不記得來處，只在乎轉售價值。
D. 我知道它不罕見，但它是記憶中家裡那件，重點不在稀有。
normal.explain: 個人物件連結不同於市場稀有性。

normal.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
normal.speak: The label says unknown maker, which is more honest than attaching the name of someone whose work merely looks similar.
options: A. 標籤寫作者不詳，比只因相似就冠上某人姓名更誠實。
B. 相似外觀已足以確認作者，因此不詳標籤不誠實。
C. 標籤承認作者不詳，表示物件沒有任何價值。
D. 說話者建議選最有名的相似作者來吸引遊客。
normal.explain: 相似不足以確定歸屬，承認未知可更準確。

normal.desc: 【文法】The photograph shows the house ___ my grandparents used to live.
options: A. where
B. which in
C. whose
D. what
normal.explain: where 引出居住地點；若用 which 應是 in which 或 which ... in。

normal.desc: 【字彙】Which noun means an object kept because it reminds someone of a person or occasion?
options: A. receipt
B. keepsake
C. replica
D. toolkit
normal.explain: keepsake 是紀念物；replica 複製品、toolkit 工具組、receipt 收據。

normal.desc: 【語意】The display contains a replica of the original key. What is on display?
options: A. A photograph showing where the key was lost.
B. A damaged key whose shape cannot be recognised.
C. A copy made to resemble the original key.
D. The only key ever used to open the building.
normal.explain: replica 是仿製複本，不是原件保證。

normal.desc: 【文法】The box had not been opened ___ it was put in the attic thirty years earlier.
options: A. by
B. since
C. during
D. while
normal.explain: since 接起始時間事件，配過去完成式表示至過去某時未開。

normal.desc: 【短文】A visitor calls a repaired bowl worthless because it is no longer perfect. Its owner says the repair records how the family continued using it. What gives the bowl value to the owner?
options: A. Its guaranteed selling price at a public auction.
B. Its similarity to a new bowl in a shop window.
C. Its connection with the family’s history of use.
D. Its ability to prove that no damage ever occurred.
normal.explain: 價值來自使用與修補的家庭歷史，不以無損或價格為依據。

normal.desc: 【語意】The object is older than the label suggests. What is being questioned?
options: A. The physical age of the printed label.
B. The position of the label beside the object.
C. The claim that the object has been repaired.
D. The age implied by the description.
normal.explain: label suggests 指標籤傳達物件年代，不是標籤紙本年齡。

normal.desc: 【短文】A diary describes a journey as uneventful. A later entry mentions missing a train and walking several miles. The owner laughs that she had forgotten to count that as an event. What is suggested?
options: A. The later entry proves the journey never occurred.
B. The owner thinks a missed train is a form of transport.
C. The diary’s first description understates what happened.
D. The journey took place on two separate continents.
normal.explain: uneventful 與實際插曲有幽默反差，不推測造假。

normal.desc: 【語用】It is not much to look at, but I would not part with it. What is the contrast?
options: A. Its high selling price versus the cost of repairing it.
B. Its impressive size versus the space available at home.
C. Its usefulness today versus the owner’s wish to replace it.
D. Its ordinary appearance versus its personal importance.
normal.explain: not much to look at 外表不起眼，not part with 不願割愛。

normal.desc: 【短文】A room is arranged to look as it did before its owner moved away. One modern lamp was added so visitors can see the letters. Which description is most precise?
options: A. The arrangement largely recreates an earlier setting with a practical addition.
B. The arrangement contains only objects that were present before the owner left.
C. The modern lamp proves that the letters were written after the owner moved.
D. The room has been redesigned without reference to its earlier appearance.
normal.explain: 承認整體重現及實用例外，不以單件現代物否定全部。

normal.desc: 請唸出單字：使人記起某人或某事的紀念物
請唸出單字：仿照原物製作的複本
請唸出：已褪色而不易看清的題字
請唸出：鮮明清楚的回憶
請唸出：贈送日期可能不同於製造日期

normal.speak: the gift date may differ from the date of manufacture
normal.vocabId: R6:THE GIFT DATE MAY DIFFER FROM THE DATE OF MANUFACTURE

normal.desc: 請唸出：普通物件可以承載個人歷史
normal.ans: AN ORDINARY OBJECT CAN CARRY A PERSONAL HISTORY
normal.speak: an ordinary object can carry a personal history
normal.vocabId: R6:AN ORDINARY OBJECT CAN CARRY A PERSONAL HISTORY

normal.desc: 請拼出：刻寫或題寫在物上的文字（I 開頭，11 個字母）
請拼出：屋頂下方的閣樓空間（A 開頭，5 個字母）
請拼出：對過往事件的回想或記憶（R 開頭，12 個字母）
填空題：D I S _ L A Y (供人觀看的展品安排)
填空題：D O _ A T _ O N (捐出的物品或金錢)
填空題：H E _ R _ O _ M (家族世代相傳的物品)

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The delay was beyond our control.
options: A. 我們故意拖延了進度。
B. 我們完全掌控了延誤時間。
C. 我們已取消整個計畫。
D. 延誤不是我們能控制的。
boss.explain: beyond our control 指超出控制範圍，沒有表示取消計畫。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Unless we hear otherwise, we will proceed as planned.
options: A. 若未收到不同指示，我們會照原計畫進行。
B. 只有收到不同指示才會照原計畫進行。
C. 我們已決定無條件取消計畫。
D. 我們不會理會任何後續指示。
boss.explain: unless 是「除非」，otherwise 指不同消息或指示。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: We have been assured that no jobs will be lost, although the details of the restructuring have yet to be announced.
options: A. 公司已公布每個職位的調動細節。
B. 已獲不裁員的保證，但重組細節仍未公布。
C. 重組細節已公布，並確定裁掉所有員工。
D. 說話者保證重組永遠不會發生。
boss.explain: have been assured 是收到保證，have yet to be announced 是尚未公布。

boss.desc: 【語氣】Which reply accepts an invitation while making attendance conditional on finishing a report?
options: A. I would love to come, even if I never finish the report.
B. I cannot come because the report is already finished.
C. I will come instead of finishing the report.
D. I would love to come, provided I finish the report.
boss.explain: provided 表示「只要」，保留出席條件；其他選項取消條件、拒絕出席或選擇不寫報告。

boss.desc: 【推論】A supplier says the shipment is unlikely to arrive before Friday. Which statement preserves that degree of certainty?
options: A. Arrival before Friday is possible but not expected.
B. Arrival before Friday is completely impossible.
C. Arrival on Friday is guaranteed.
D. Arrival before Friday is more likely than not.
boss.explain: unlikely 是機率低而非不可能，也沒有保證週五到貨。

boss.desc: 【短文】An online course reports that its graduates earn more than non-graduates. Yet applicants already had above-average salaries before enrolling. Which concern most directly challenges the implied benefit?
options: A. Graduates necessarily worked fewer hours.
B. The salary difference may predate participation in the course.
C. The course must have lowered every graduate’s salary.
D. Non-graduates cannot learn online.
boss.explain: 入學前薪資差異可能造成結果，不能直接把較高薪資歸因於課程；其他敘述都沒有證據。

boss.desc: 請唸出：仔細檢視後
boss.speak: on closer inspection

boss.desc: 請唸出：仍有很大的改善空間
boss.ans: THERE IS CONSIDERABLE ROOM FOR IMPROVEMENT
boss.speak: there is considerable room for improvement
boss.vocabId: R6:THERE IS CONSIDERABLE ROOM FOR IMPROVEMENT

boss.desc: 填空題：C O N T I _ G E N C Y (可能發生而須預作準備的意外情況)
boss.speak: contingency

boss.desc: 填空題：R E P _ R C _ S S _ O N (事件帶來的間接負面後果)
boss.speak: repercussion

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: We can hold the room for you until tomorrow afternoon.
options: A. 我們可以替你保留房間到明天下午。
B. 你必須在明天下午前搬出已入住的房間。
C. 房間要到下個月才會完工。
D. 你已經預付了全部房費。
boss.explain: hold the room 是暫時保留訂房機會，沒有說已付款或必須退房。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I had been looking forward to the concert, so finding out it had been cancelled was a real letdown.
options: A. 演唱會只是延期，日期已經確定。
B. 因原本很期待演唱會，得知取消令說話者失望。
C. 說話者原本就不想參加，因此很高興取消。
D. 說話者直到演出結束才知道有演唱會。
boss.explain: look forward to 是期待，letdown 是令人失望的事；cancelled 不等於已確定延期。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: If we had booked the direct service, we would not be changing trains now, but at least we saved a fair amount.
options: A. 說話者正在討論明年才可能發生的行程。
B. 說話者認為轉乘和票價都與訂票選擇無關。
C. 選了較便宜的轉乘路線，現在得換車，但省了不少錢。
D. 訂了直達車，所以現在不用換車且費用較低。
boss.explain: 混合條件句把過去未選直達與現在轉乘連起來；at least 保留省錢這個好處。

boss.desc: 【搭配詞】The union and management finally reached a ___ after weeks of negotiation.
options: A. compromise
B. compression
C. comparison
D. composition
boss.explain: reach a compromise 是達成妥協；其餘分別是壓縮、比較及構成或作品。

boss.desc: 【文法】The museum opened ten years ago. By the time it closes for renovation next June, it ___ visitors for eleven years.
options: A. would have welcoming
B. will have welcomed
C. will welcome
D. has been welcomed
boss.explain: By...next June 設定未來完成的時間點，用 will have＋過去分詞；museum 是接待者，不是被接待者。

boss.desc: 【短文】A restaurant says its menu is seasonal. When a customer complains that a favourite dish has disappeared, the owner explains that its main ingredient is no longer locally available. Which response follows the restaurant’s stated approach?
options: A. Claiming that seasonal menus must contain only cold food.
B. Removing all local ingredients from future menus.
C. Offering a different dish made with ingredients currently available locally.
D. Promising to serve every dish unchanged throughout the year.
boss.explain: 隨季節與當地食材調整菜單，提供當季替代菜色符合原則；不是全年固定不變。

boss.desc: 請唸出：在你方便時儘早
boss.speak: at your earliest convenience

boss.desc: 請唸出：保存這棟建物仍是我們最優先的事
boss.ans: PRESERVING THE BUILDING REMAINS OUR OVERRIDING PRIORITY
boss.speak: preserving the building remains our overriding priority
boss.vocabId: R6:PRESERVING THE BUILDING REMAINS OUR OVERRIDING PRIORITY

boss.desc: 填空題：R E C I P _ O C I T Y (相互給予或回應的互惠原則)
boss.speak: reciprocity

boss.desc: 填空題：R E F _ R B _ S H _ E N T (建築或設備的翻新整修)
boss.speak: refurbishment

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The update is designed to address the issue, not merely hide it.
options: A. 更新的唯一作用是隱藏使用者姓名。
B. 更新是為了解決問題，而不只是把它藏起來。
C. 更新只會把問題藏起來，而且沒有其他目的。
D. 問題已不存在，所以不需要更新。
boss.explain: address the issue 是處理問題；not merely 表示不只停留在掩蓋。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The new tool saves time on routine tasks, although checking the results still requires human judgement.
options: A. 人工檢查只會讓所有結果變錯。
B. 工具只能用來測量人類反應時間。
C. 工具能省下例行工作的時間，但檢查結果仍需人工判斷。
D. 工具已完全取代任何人工判斷。
boss.explain: although 保留人工驗證需求；save time 不等於免除責任或判斷。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The screenshot may be genuine, but without the surrounding conversation we cannot be sure what the message was responding to.
options: A. 截圖真實就能保證所有解讀都正確。
B. 缺少前後文足以證明截圖是偽造的。
C. 我們已經完整掌握對話中的每個細節。
D. 截圖可能是真的，但缺少前後文就難以確定訊息回應的是什麼。
boss.explain: 區分影像真實性與語境完整性；缺脈絡不直接證明造假。

boss.desc: 【搭配詞】Please ___ your sources before sharing a claim that could affect other people’s decisions.
options: A. amplify
B. verify
C. notify
D. satisfy
boss.explain: verify 是核實；notify 通知、satisfy 滿足、amplify 放大均不合此目的。

boss.desc: 【推測】The file was encrypted, and only Mara had the key. If someone read it without asking her, they ___ another way to access it.
options: A. will have been finding
B. are finding
C. must have found
D. must find
boss.explain: 已讀取是過去事件，根據線索推測應用 must have found；不表達現在或未來。

boss.desc: 【短文】An article links to an original study, but its headline replaces a possible association with a claim of proven cause. Why should the reader check the study itself?
options: A. Linking to a study guarantees that every headline is accurate.
B. A possible association always proves a direct cause.
C. The original study must reach the opposite conclusion to the headline.
D. The headline may overstate what the research supports.
boss.explain: possible association 與 proven cause 的證據強度不同；需要核對，不能先斷定原研究一定相反。

boss.desc: 請唸出：帶有若干保留地
boss.speak: with certain reservations

boss.desc: 請唸出：這項建議取決於你的具體需求
boss.ans: THE RECOMMENDATION DEPENDS ON YOUR PARTICULAR REQUIREMENTS
boss.speak: the recommendation depends on your particular requirements
boss.vocabId: R6:THE RECOMMENDATION DEPENDS ON YOUR PARTICULAR REQUIREMENTS

boss.desc: 請拼出：容易受攻擊或傷害的弱點（V 開頭，13 個字母）
boss.speak: vulnerability

boss.desc: 填空題：V E R _ F I _ A T _ O N (核對說法或資料是否正確的過程)
boss.speak: verification

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The plan is ambitious, but we need to be realistic about the resources available.
options: A. 資源已確定足以完成任何目標。
B. 說話者主張立即取消所有計畫。
C. 計畫有企圖心，但必須務實看待可用資源。
D. 只要計畫夠大，就不需要考慮資源。
boss.explain: ambitious 與 realistic 的對照保留目標，也提出資源限制。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The trees were planted to provide shade, although it will be years before they make a noticeable difference.
options: A. 樹木種下當天就已提供完整遮蔭。
B. 因為無法立即遮蔭，所有樹木已被移除。
C. 種樹的唯一目的是測量時間。
D. 種樹是為了遮蔭，但要多年後才有明顯效果。
boss.explain: 目的與見效時程分開表達，沒有說計畫已取消。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I would welcome the improvement, but only if the households most affected by the work have a genuine say in how it is carried out.
options: A. 我願支持改善，但條件是受影響最大的住戶能實際參與執行方式的決定。
B. 只要宣布工程，住戶就不需要再表達意見。
C. 我反對讓任何住戶參與。
D. 受影響最大的住戶已獲准單獨決定一切。
boss.explain: only if 明示必要條件；genuine say 是實質發言權，非單獨掌控所有決策。

boss.desc: 【搭配詞】The housing proposal met with strong ___ from people concerned about traffic.
options: A. oppose
B. opposing it
C. opposition
D. oppositionally
boss.explain: met with strong opposition 是遭遇強烈反對，此處需名詞。

boss.desc: 【推測】The river was clear yesterday but muddy after the overnight storm. The rain ___ soil into it.
options: A. may wash tomorrow
B. is to wash
C. has washing
D. may have washed
boss.explain: 對過去原因作可能性推測用 may have＋過去分詞；沒有把可能原因說成確證。

boss.desc: 【短文】A refill shop counts every reused bottle as one disposable bottle avoided. Some customers previously used tap water and bought no bottles. What could make the reported saving too large?
options: A. Assuming all refills replace purchases that would otherwise have occurred.
B. Counting only customers who had previously bought bottled products.
C. Separating new customers from existing bottle users.
D. Checking what customers used before visiting the shop.
boss.explain: 未有原本購買行為就不能當成替代了購買；後三項反而有助釐清估計。

boss.desc: 請唸出：數量有限的資源
boss.speak: a finite resource

boss.desc: 請唸出：短期節省可能造成長期問題
boss.ans: SHORT TERM SAVINGS MAY CREATE LASTING PROBLEMS
boss.speak: short term savings may create lasting problems
boss.vocabId: R6:SHORT TERM SAVINGS MAY CREATE LASTING PROBLEMS

boss.desc: 請拼出：價格在可負擔範圍內的程度（A 開頭，13 個字母）
boss.speak: affordability

boss.desc: 填空題：I N F _ A S T _ U C _ U R E (交通供水等支撐社會運作的基礎設施)
boss.speak: infrastructure

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: You do not have to understand every word to follow the main argument.
options: A. 不懂每個字就一定無法理解任何內容。
B. 只要懂一個字就必定掌握所有細節。
C. 課程不會提供任何字彙說明。
D. 掌握主要論點不一定需要懂每個字。
boss.explain: do not have to 是否定必要性，不保證完全不需字彙知識。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The deadline can be extended in exceptional circumstances, but you should not assume that an extension is automatic.
options: A. 特殊情況可延期，但不能當成自動獲准。
B. 所有人不必申請就一定能延期。
C. 任何特殊情況都不允許延期。
D. 延期已被批准且不需要再確認。
boss.explain: can 表可能獲准，not automatic 表仍有條件或程序。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: It is tempting to choose the familiar expression, but the question is testing whether it suits this particular relationship between the speakers.
options: A. 本題只測拼字，完全不涉及使用情境。
B. 熟悉表達容易讓人想選，但本題考的是它是否適合說話者關係。
C. 最熟悉的說法在每種關係中都最恰當。
D. 說話者之間的關係不會影響語氣。
boss.explain: familiarity 與 appropriateness 不同，語域取決於關係。

boss.desc: 【搭配詞】The course aims to bridge the ___ between theoretical knowledge and practical use.
options: A. gasp
B. grip
C. glimpse
D. gap
boss.explain: bridge the gap 是縮小差距；其餘詞不表理論與實務間的落差。

boss.desc: 【句意】The instructor distinguished memorising a rule from knowing when to apply it. What distinction is made?
options: A. Recalling information is different from using it appropriately.
B. Memorising always prevents any later application.
C. Rules can only be used by people unable to recall them.
D. Appropriate use never requires knowledge of a rule.
boss.explain: 記住規則與依情境使用不同；沒有主張兩者互斥。

boss.desc: 【短文】A school compares this year’s average score with last year’s, but this year’s test used shorter texts and allowed more time. What should be considered before attributing the rise to improved teaching?
options: A. A higher average guarantees that each student improved.
B. The changes to the assessment may have affected the scores.
C. Shorter texts always test a more advanced skill.
D. More time proves that students studied less.
boss.explain: 測驗條件同時改變，不能直接把平均提升單獨歸因於教學。

boss.desc: 請唸出：短期內需要學習很多內容的過程
boss.speak: a steep learning curve

boss.desc: 請唸出：熟悉不應被誤當成精熟
boss.ans: FAMILIARITY SHOULD NOT BE MISTAKEN FOR MASTERY
boss.speak: familiarity should not be mistaken for mastery
boss.vocabId: R6:FAMILIARITY SHOULD NOT BE MISTAKEN FOR MASTERY

boss.desc: 請拼出：對自己的思考與學習過程的覺察（M 開頭，13 個字母）
boss.speak: metacognition

boss.desc: 填空題：M I S _ O N _ E P _ I O N (對某事形成的錯誤理解)
boss.speak: misconception

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The story works better when it trusts the audience to make the connection.
options: A. 故事讓觀眾自行建立關聯時效果更好。
B. 故事只有把每個暗示都直接解說才有效。
C. 觀眾不應試著理解故事中的關聯。
D. 故事必須先證明所有觀眾彼此認識。
boss.explain: trust the audience 表相信觀眾的理解能力。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The character is sympathetic without being particularly admirable.
options: A. 說話者認為同情和欽佩必定相同。
B. 角色讓人能同情，卻未必值得欽佩。
C. 角色受到欽佩，但完全無法引起同情。
D. 角色因沒有缺點而讓人同情。
boss.explain: sympathetic 與 admirable 是不同評價，不能混同。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The quotation is accurate, but removing the next sentence makes it sound like the author supports a view she immediately goes on to question.
options: A. 作者在下一句更強烈支持同一觀點。
B. 只要引文字面正確，前後文就永遠不影響意思。
C. 引文文字正確，但刪掉下一句後，作者被誤呈現為支持隨即遭她質疑的觀點。
D. 引文本身每個字都已被改寫。
boss.explain: 準確摘字不保證立場呈現準確，後句改變論述功能。

boss.desc: 【文法】By the end of the opening chapter, the narrator ___ three times without explaining why.
options: A. has disappeared
B. have disappeared
C. is disappeared by
D. has disappearing
boss.explain: 主詞單數 narrator 配 has＋過去分詞；題幹以閱讀進程中的現在觀點描述。

boss.desc: 【短文】A review praises the actors but says the dialogue repeatedly explains feelings the performances already convey. What is the criticism?
options: A. The reviewer objects to the presence of any dialogue.
B. The script supplies explanations that the acting has made unnecessary.
C. The actors fail to express the characters’ feelings.
D. The dialogue and acting communicate unrelated stories.
boss.explain: already convey 表演已傳達，重複說明可能多餘；未否定所有對白。

boss.desc: 【短文】A comedy repeatedly lets viewers know something the main character does not. When he confidently acts on his mistaken belief, the audience anticipates the problem. What creates the effect?
options: A. The story withholds every relevant fact from the audience.
B. The character accurately predicts every consequence.
C. The audience’s knowledge exceeds the character’s.
D. The audience and character are given identical information at every moment.
boss.explain: 觀眾知道而角色不知的資訊落差製造戲劇效果。

boss.desc: 請唸出：反覆出現的意象
boss.speak: a recurring image

boss.desc: 請唸出：引文需要放回前後文中閱讀
boss.ans: THE QUOTATION NEEDS TO BE READ IN CONTEXT
boss.speak: the quotation needs to be read in context
boss.vocabId: R6:THE QUOTATION NEEDS TO BE READ IN CONTEXT

boss.desc: 請拼出：以形象或事物表達更深意思的手法（S 開頭，9 個字母）
boss.speak: symbolism

boss.desc: 填空題：N A _ R _ T _ V E (將事件組織成故事的敘述)
boss.speak: narrative

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I can take that on, as long as we agree which of my current tasks can wait.
options: A. 我只在要求把新工作永久取消。
B. 只要先說定哪些現有工作能延後，我就能接下來。
C. 我已無條件答應同時完成所有工作。
D. 我拒絕討論任何現有工作的安排。
boss.explain: 接新任務以重新安排優先順序為條件。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The request sounds reasonable in isolation, but we need to consider what happens if every department asks for the same exception.
options: A. 所有部門目前都已提出完全相同申請。
B. 任何例外都被說話者視為不合理。
C. 單看要求似乎合理，但還得考量各部門都要求同一例外的影響。
D. 要求因來自單一部門就已自動獲准。
boss.explain: in isolation 對照全局與先例效果，沒有預設已普遍發生。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: It is not that I doubt your judgement; I need a record of the reasoning so that the decision can be explained to people who were not in the room.
options: A. 我要求紀錄是因已證明你的決定不誠實。
B. 只要有與會者就不必再對外說明。
C. 我只需要名單，不需要任何推理內容。
D. 我不是質疑你的判斷，而是需要理由紀錄，以便向未與會者解釋。
boss.explain: 明確區分信任個人與可說明、可追溯的決策需求。

boss.desc: 【語域】Which reply asks for clarification without rejecting the request?
options: A. You should not have asked me in the first place.
B. Could you clarify which part you would like me to prioritise?
C. I am refusing to do any part of this task.
D. There is nothing to clarify, and I have already finished.
boss.explain: clarify 與 prioritise 詢問工作範圍與順序，未直接拒絕。

boss.desc: 【句意】The approval applies to the trial period only. Which interpretation respects the limit?
options: A. The trial cannot take place under any circumstances.
B. Approval automatically applies to every future project.
C. Permission for the trial does not by itself authorise permanent use.
D. Permanent use has already been approved.
boss.explain: only 限定核准範圍，不可延伸為永久授權。

boss.desc: 【短文】Two suppliers offer the same price. One promises delivery in three days; the other gives a seven-day deadline with compensation if it is missed. The buyer values an enforceable commitment. What distinction matters?
options: A. The cheaper supplier has necessarily offered the stronger guarantee.
B. The three-day promise proves delivery will happen sooner.
C. Compensation removes every possible consequence of delay.
D. A target delivery time is different from a deadline backed by a stated remedy.
boss.explain: 買方關切承諾及未履行補救，不是僅比較較短天數。此為虛構合約語境。

boss.desc: 請唸出：在約定範圍之內
boss.speak: within the agreed scope

boss.desc: 請唸出：彈性不會取消負責的必要
boss.ans: FLEXIBILITY DOES NOT REMOVE THE NEED FOR ACCOUNTABILITY
boss.speak: flexibility does not remove the need for accountability
boss.vocabId: R6:FLEXIBILITY DOES NOT REMOVE THE NEED FOR ACCOUNTABILITY

boss.desc: 請拼出：使不同人或活動互相配合的協調（C 開頭，12 個字母）
boss.speak: coordination

boss.desc: 填空題：C O _ M I _ M _ N T (願意履行的承諾或投入)
boss.speak: commitment

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I appreciate the invitation, but I would rather keep the weekend free.
options: A. 我要求你取消自己的週末安排。
B. 我認為邀請本身是不禮貌的。
C. 我感謝邀請，但比較想保留週末空檔。
D. 我已答應週末全程出席。
boss.explain: 感謝與婉拒可以並存，would rather 表偏好。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: She may have sounded abrupt, but I do not think she intended to be unkind.
options: A. 她已承認故意冒犯所有人。
B. 只要語氣生硬就能確定惡意。
C. 說話者沒有注意到任何語氣差異。
D. 她聽來可能生硬，但我不認為她有意不友善。
boss.explain: 區分可觀察語氣與對意圖的推論。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: What I need is not another assurance that you meant well, but a clearer agreement about what will happen differently next time.
options: A. 我需要的不是再次保證出於好意，而是說清楚下次會怎樣改變。
B. 我只想知道你是否有好意，不在乎後續做法。
C. 我已拒絕討論任何下一次安排。
D. 我認為說清楚具體做法就能保證永不出錯。
boss.explain: 要求由動機保證移向具體行動安排，未保證零失誤。

boss.desc: 【字彙】Which adjective means confident in expressing a view without being aggressive?
options: A. indecisive
B. submissive
C. assertive
D. secretive
boss.explain: assertive 指有自信清楚表達立場，與攻擊性不同。

boss.desc: 【短文】A neighbour says visitors are welcome, but asks that shared doors not be left open. Which action meets both parts of the message?
options: A. Treat the message as a ban on all visitors.
B. Leave every door open to show visitors are welcome.
C. Assume visitors may ignore all shared arrangements.
D. Invite visitors while keeping the shared doors closed when unattended.
boss.explain: 歡迎訪客不代表取消公共出入口的要求。

boss.desc: 【短文】A flatmate agrees to quiet hours after ten but uses headphones only for music, leaving loud calls on speaker. What needs to be clarified?
options: A. Whether quiet hours apply to the noise produced, not merely to one source of it.
B. Whether headphones can ever play music.
C. Whether the clock has been set to another time zone.
D. Whether quiet hours automatically end after one agreement.
boss.explain: 安靜要求應釐清涵蓋各類噪音，而非只針對音樂設備。

boss.desc: 請唸出：事先已有的承諾或安排
boss.speak: a prior commitment

boss.desc: 請唸出：清楚拒絕比不可靠的安慰更體貼
boss.ans: A CLEAR REFUSAL IS KINDER THAN UNRELIABLE REASSURANCE
boss.speak: a clear refusal is kinder than unreliable reassurance
boss.vocabId: R6:A CLEAR REFUSAL IS KINDER THAN UNRELIABLE REASSURANCE

boss.desc: 請拼出：回應對方的感情善意或協助（R 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.speak: reciprocate

boss.desc: 填空題：R E _ O _ C _ L E (使衝突的人事或觀點重新相容)
boss.speak: reconcile

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: We can change the booking, but the difference in fare will still apply.
options: A. 改訂已保證所有費用完全相同。
B. 票價差額會使改訂在任何情況都不可能。
C. 只有取消旅程才可保留原訂位。
D. 可以改訂，但仍須處理票價差額。
boss.explain: 能變更不代表免除差價。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The alternative is slightly longer on paper, but it avoids a transfer that often causes problems.
options: A. 替代路線表定稍長，但避開常出問題的轉乘。
B. 表定稍長就代表實際上必然更慢。
C. 替代路線增加了同一個麻煩轉乘。
D. 說話者已保證任一路線都不會延誤。
boss.explain: 表定時長與實際風險權衡不同，沒有確定總耗時結果。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The confirmation sounded reassuring until we noticed that it confirmed receipt of the request, rather than availability of the service.
options: A. 通知明確拒絕受理任何要求。
B. 確認通知令人安心，直到發現它只確認收到申請，並未確認服務可用。
C. 通知已同時確認申請和服務都完成。
D. 收到申請就必然保證服務有空位。
boss.explain: receipt 與 availability 是不同確認對象。

boss.desc: 【搭配詞】The route is closed, so drivers must take a ___.
options: A. departure
B. destination
C. duration
D. detour
boss.explain: detour 是繞道；其他詞是出發、目的地與時長。

boss.desc: 【短文】An airline offers meal vouchers during a delay. The notice says accepting a voucher does not settle any separate complaint about the journey. What does acceptance not imply?
options: A. That every other concern has been resolved.
B. That the passenger may receive the specified meal benefit.
C. That a delay has affected the service.
D. That the airline has issued a notice.
boss.explain: 餐券接受與其他爭議處理被明確分開，不應自行擴張。

boss.desc: 【短文】A route planner selects the quickest journey by adding scheduled travel times. It ignores the ten-minute walk between two different stations with similar names. What is missing?
options: A. A reason why scheduled travel time can never be useful.
B. A practical transfer requirement not included in the time calculation.
C. The distinction between morning and evening fares.
D. Proof that all station names refer to one building.
boss.explain: 步行轉乘是必要但未計入的時間，不能只相加行車分鐘。

boss.desc: 請唸出：另一條可採用的路線
boss.speak: an alternative route

boss.desc: 請唸出：已說明的保證有範圍限制
boss.ans: THE STATED GUARANTEE HAS A LIMITED SCOPE
boss.speak: the stated guarantee has a limited scope
boss.vocabId: R6:THE STATED GUARANTEE HAS A LIMITED SCOPE

boss.desc: 請拼出：是否發生取決於某項條件的（C 開頭，10 個字母）
boss.speak: contingent

boss.desc: 填空題：A C _ E S _ I _ L E (容易到達或適合不同需求者使用的)
boss.speak: accessible

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The road is open, but that does not mean the danger has passed.
options: A. 道路開通不代表危險已消失。
B. 只要開通就能保證毫無風險。
C. 道路已因危險而永久封閉。
D. 說話者確認從來沒有危險。
boss.explain: 可通行與安全性是不同判斷。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Her allegiance is to the people of the valley, not necessarily to whoever occupies the throne.
options: A. 她已宣布自己要立即登基。
B. 她忠於山谷人民，不一定忠於坐在王位上的任何人。
C. 她保證無論誰掌權都無條件服從。
D. 她對山谷居民完全沒有責任感。
boss.explain: 忠誠對象區分人民與掌權者。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The warning may be intended to protect us, but we should still ask whether it describes a danger or merely discourages a question.
options: A. 所有警告都只能是欺騙。
B. 只要有人問問題就能證明危險不存在。
C. 警告可能出於保護，但仍須問它在描述危險，還是在阻止提問。
D. 保護意圖已保證每項警告事實正確。
boss.explain: 善意可能性不免除內容與話語功能的檢驗。

boss.desc: 【字彙】Which verb means to give up a claim or possession, often reluctantly?
options: A. relinquish
B. replenish
C. reprimand
D. replicate
boss.explain: relinquish 是放棄交出；其他動詞分別補充、斥責、複製。

boss.desc: 【短文】The map marks a passage as hidden, not blocked. The group has not found its entrance. What conclusion is warranted?
options: A. A hidden passage must have an entrance visible from every direction.
B. The passage may exist even though its entrance has not been located.
C. The map explicitly states that no passage exists.
D. The group has already proved the route impassable.
boss.explain: 未發現不等於不存在；hidden 和 blocked 的資訊不同。

boss.desc: 【短文】The villagers call a tower cursed because everyone who entered returned frightened. The scout notes that none described what they saw. What should the group distinguish?
options: A. A description of events from a map of the village.
B. Proof of a curse from the villagers’ complete lack of concern.
C. Evidence of fear from evidence of a particular cause of that fear.
D. An absence of fear from certainty that the tower is safe.
boss.explain: 恐懼反應存在，不足以確定超自然原因。

boss.desc: 請唸出：不易被發現的通道
boss.speak: a hidden passage

boss.desc: 請唸出：我們應區分警告與解釋
boss.ans: WE SHOULD DISTINGUISH A WARNING FROM AN EXPLANATION
boss.speak: we should distinguish a warning from an explanation
boss.vocabId: R6:WE SHOULD DISTINGUISH A WARNING FROM AN EXPLANATION

boss.desc: 請拼出：恢復原本的職位權利或安排（R 開頭，9 個字母）
boss.speak: reinstate

boss.desc: 填空題：V I _ I _ A _ C E (持續留意可能危險的警覺)
boss.speak: vigilance

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: good value for money
options: A. 品質完全不受價格影響
B. 以所付價格而言很划算
C. 價格必定是全市最低
D. 任何人都不用付錢
boss.explain: value for money 評估價格與所得價值，不保證最低價。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: We do have a quiet room, though it is upstairs and there is no lift.
options: A. 所有房間都一樣吵且無法選擇。
B. 說話者保證每位客人都能輕鬆進入。
C. 確實有安靜房間，但在樓上且沒有電梯。
D. 安靜房間位於有電梯的地面層。
boss.explain: 承認優點並指出可及性限制，不作個人能力推斷。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Her review is enthusiastic about the cooking, less so about what she considers an unnecessarily formal atmosphere.
options: A. 她完全否定料理但喜歡正式氣氛。
B. 她宣稱所有客人都厭惡正式餐廳。
C. 料理與氣氛都被她同樣熱烈稱讚。
D. 她很欣賞料理，對自己認為過度正式的氣氛則較不熱衷。
boss.explain: less so 承接 enthusiastic，作程度較低的評價。

boss.desc: 【字彙】Which adjective describes food that tastes pleasantly of strong spices, rather than food with no noticeable flavour?
options: A. bland
B. flavourful
C. tasteless
D. unseasoned
boss.explain: flavourful 是有豐富滋味；其餘描述少味或未調味。

boss.desc: 【短文】A restaurant offers a cheaper set menu only before six. A guest arrives at six thirty with a photograph of the offer showing its time limit. Why may the advertised price not apply?
options: A. The restaurant has necessarily changed its menu.
B. The offer is restricted to customers without photographs.
C. The guest has arrived outside the stated period.
D. The photograph must have been altered.
boss.explain: 時間條件已明示；超過時段可解釋不適用，不推測造假。

boss.desc: 【短文】A menu describes a dish as traditional. The chef explains that the recipe varies between neighbouring villages. What does this suggest?
options: A. The dish has no connection with any established practice.
B. One village must have copied a recipe incorrectly.
C. The chef has proved that all versions taste identical.
D. A tradition can contain variation rather than a single fixed recipe.
boss.explain: traditional 不必等於唯一不變版本；地方差異不自動否定傳統。

boss.desc: 請唸出：取決於個人喜好的事
boss.speak: a matter of taste

boss.desc: 請唸出：服務慢但員工很友善
boss.ans: THE SERVICE WAS SLOW BUT THE STAFF WERE FRIENDLY
boss.speak: the service was slow but the staff were friendly
boss.vocabId: R6:THE SERVICE WAS SLOW BUT THE STAFF WERE FRIENDLY

boss.desc: 請拼出：與主菜一起供應的配菜或佐食（A 開頭，13 個字母）
boss.speak: accompaniment

boss.desc: 填空題：H O _ E _ A _ E (在家製作或依家庭方式製作的)
boss.speak: homemade

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: a telltale sign
options: A. 禁止說話的標誌
B. 完全不能提供線索的記號
C. 能透露某事存在的跡象
D. 故意編造的故事標題
boss.explain: telltale 作形容詞指洩露情況的。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: We are unlikely to see much from here unless the fog clears.
options: A. 即使霧很濃也確定能看清一切。
B. 霧散後仍已確定不能看到任何東西。
C. 說話者要求大家立即停止觀察。
D. 除非霧散，否則從這裡大概看不到太多。
boss.explain: unless 提出能見度改善的必要條件，unlikely 留機率。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The guide described the walk as gentle, but that was before she knew how much of the path had been washed away.
options: A. 導遊先說路程輕鬆，當時還不知道步道有多少被沖毀。
B. 導遊是在充分了解損壞後保證輕鬆。
C. 步道損壞已被確認完全不影響路程。
D. 導遊只是在形容說話聲音柔和。
boss.explain: before she knew 限定最初評估的資訊狀態。

boss.desc: 【語用】You might want to bring a notebook, says the guide before a birdwatching walk. What is the likely function?
options: A. A prediction that notebooks will be sold out.
B. A statement that the listener already owns a notebook.
C. A suggestion to prepare for recording observations.
D. A demand to hand over all existing notes.
boss.explain: You might want to ... 在此是委婉建議，而非宣告對方欲望。

boss.desc: 【語意】The guide could identify the tree by its bark alone. What information was sufficient?
options: A. The sound made by a dog nearby.
B. The shape of every leaf and flower together.
C. The place where the guide had bought the tree.
D. The appearance of the tree’s outer covering.
boss.explain: bark 在樹木語境指樹皮，alone 表只靠這項特徵。

boss.desc: 【短文】The leaflet calls the route easy, but gives no distance or description of the ground. A walker who uses a stick asks for more detail. What is the issue?
options: A. A general label may not provide enough information for an individual’s needs.
B. The leaflet has explicitly forbidden walking sticks.
C. The walker has already completed the route without difficulty.
D. An easy route must be suitable for everyone in the same way.
boss.explain: easy 的相對評價不能代替距離、地面等可用資訊。

boss.desc: 請唸出：可供信賴的野外辨識手冊
boss.speak: a reliable field guide

boss.desc: 請唸出：沒看見動物不證明牠不存在
boss.ans: NOT SEEING AN ANIMAL DOES NOT PROVE ITS ABSENCE
boss.speak: not seeing an animal does not prove its absence
boss.vocabId: R6:NOT SEEING AN ANIMAL DOES NOT PROVE ITS ABSENCE

boss.desc: 請拼出：主要在夜間活動的（N 開頭，9 個字母）
boss.speak: nocturnal

boss.desc: 填空題：W A _ E R _ R _ O F (能防止水穿透的)
boss.speak: waterproof

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: a close call
options: A. 裁判已把比賽正式取消
B. 隔著近距離打電話
C. 提早結束且毫無懸念的比賽
D. 差一點出事或結果難分的驚險情況
boss.explain: close call 可指險些出事或難定的判斷，重點在接近界線。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I would rather play a shorter match properly than rush through a full one.
options: A. 我寧可好好打一場較短比賽，也不願匆忙打完整場。
B. 我寧可匆忙打完規定全程也不縮短。
C. 我想取消比賽改成討論規則。
D. 我只願看短比賽而不想參與。
boss.explain: rather 比較兩個參與方式，不是拒絕打球。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The results matter to me, just not enough to make me give up enjoying the afternoon.
options: A. 我願意為了贏而放棄任何休閒活動。
B. 我在意結果，但不至於犧牲下午的樂趣。
C. 我只要輸就會認定下午毫無價值。
D. 我對結果完全不感興趣也不會查看。
boss.explain: just not enough 限制程度，非否定在意。

boss.desc: 【語用】Would you mind keeping the score while I play? What is requested?
options: A. Explaining how to improve technique.
B. Changing the number of points needed.
C. Playing in place of the speaker.
D. Recording points during the game.
boss.explain: keep the score 是記分，不是保存球具。

boss.desc: 【語意】The coach praised her effort, if not her accuracy. What is the assessment?
options: A. Her effort deserved praise, but her accuracy did not receive the same approval.
B. Her accuracy deserved praise, but her effort did not receive the same approval.
C. Her effort would deserve praise only if she first improved her accuracy.
D. Her accuracy was praised because the coach considered effort irrelevant.
boss.explain: if not 在此限制讚美範圍，努力受肯定而準確性有所保留。

boss.desc: 【短文】A player wins a match after her opponent slips. She says the result was welcome but not a fair measure of their usual abilities. What distinction does she make?
options: A. Her opponent’s footwear versus the condition of her own equipment.
B. Winning this match versus demonstrating greater skill overall.
C. Being pleased with a win versus wanting to play the match again.
D. Following the rules versus receiving permission to enter the event.
boss.explain: 單次結果可能受意外影響，不能直接代表平常實力。

boss.desc: 請唸出：穩定逐步的進步
boss.speak: a steady improvement

boss.desc: 請唸出：我重視結果但不讓它毀掉一天
boss.ans: I VALUE THE RESULT WITHOUT LETTING IT SPOIL THE DAY
boss.speak: i value the result without letting it spoil the day
boss.vocabId: R6:I VALUE THE RESULT WITHOUT LETTING IT SPOIL THE DAY

boss.desc: 請拼出：遇困難仍持續努力的毅力（P 開頭，12 個字母）
boss.speak: perseverance

boss.desc: 填空題：D _ _ _ (雙方得分相同的平手結果)
boss.speak: draw

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: word of mouth
options: A. 透過人們口頭相傳
B. 按照書面逐字朗讀
C. 由新聞機構正式公告
D. 用嘴形而不發聲表達
boss.explain: word of mouth 指人際口頭傳播。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Could you make clear which part is your opinion and which part you heard from someone else?
options: A. 請把所有人的名字換成相同的稱呼。
B. 請分清哪些是你的看法、哪些是聽別人說的。
C. 請把別人的看法改寫成自己的親身經歷。
D. 請只留下你贊成而刪除你不同意的部分。
boss.explain: 要求區分資訊來源與個人判斷，不是篩選立場。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The apology explains how the error happened, but it does not quite acknowledge the trouble it caused.
options: A. 道歉把全部原因歸給受影響的人。
B. 道歉確認錯誤並未帶來任何不便。
C. 道歉解釋錯誤如何發生，卻未充分承認造成的困擾。
D. 道歉承認造成困擾，但拒絕說明錯誤原因。
boss.explain: 原因說明與承認後果不同；not quite 是有保留的批評。

boss.desc: 【語用】Could you send me the original message rather than a screenshot of part of it? What does the speaker want?
options: A. Access to the complete message in its original form.
B. A clearer photograph of the same selected sentence.
C. Permission to forward the selected sentence publicly.
D. A summary replacing both the message and the screenshot.
boss.explain: original rather than screenshot of part 強調取得原文完整脈絡。

boss.desc: 【語意】The reply was polite but noncommittal. What remained unclear?
options: A. Whether the request had been written in a message.
B. Whether the sender was agreeing to the request.
C. Whether the sender had used courteous language.
D. Whether the message had been sent as a reply.
boss.explain: noncommittal 不明確承諾或表態；禮貌不等於同意。

boss.desc: 【短文】A newsletter corrects a false date but leaves an accusation that depended on that date unchanged. A reader asks whether the correction goes far enough. What should be reconsidered?
options: A. The need to preserve the newsletter’s original publication time.
B. The reader’s ability to remember the earlier date accurately.
C. The accusation’s basis once the date has changed.
D. The size of the font used to print the corrected date.
boss.explain: 若推論依錯誤日期而成立，改日期後須重評推論。

boss.desc: 請唸出：尚未獲證實的報導
boss.speak: an unconfirmed report

boss.desc: 請唸出：正確引文仍可能漏掉重要脈絡
boss.ans: AN ACCURATE QUOTATION CAN STILL OMIT IMPORTANT CONTEXT
boss.speak: an accurate quotation can still omit important context
boss.vocabId: R6:AN ACCURATE QUOTATION CAN STILL OMIT IMPORTANT CONTEXT

boss.desc: 請拼出：錯誤理解某事的意思（M 開頭，12 個字母）
boss.speak: misinterpret

boss.desc: 填空題：A T _ R I _ U T _ O N (交代言論或作品來源的做法)
boss.speak: attribution

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: clear the air
options: A. 把所有東西搬到戶外
B. 把誤會或緊張談開
C. 把窗戶玻璃擦乾淨
D. 正式宣布結束租約
boss.explain: clear the air 慣用指化解緊張誤會。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The spare room is available, provided you do not need it before the boxes have been collected.
options: A. 空房只能在箱子被取走前暫時使用。
B. 說話者已確認箱子今天一定會被取走。
C. 空房可用，前提是你不需要在箱子被取走前用。
D. 箱子留在空房多久都不會影響使用。
boss.explain: 條件限定可使用時間，未給取件確切日期。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: I appreciate the offer to help; I would just rather decide together what needs changing before anyone starts.
options: A. 我會接受幫忙，但只有你自行決定改動才有效率。
B. 我拒絕任何改動，也不願再討論是否幫忙。
C. 我希望你先做完，之後我再說哪些不該改。
D. 謝謝願意幫忙，只希望開始前先一起決定改什麼。
boss.explain: 接受善意並要求先共同決策，非全盤拒絕。

boss.desc: 【語用】Could we keep this shelf for things we both use? What is proposed?
options: A. Replacing both people’s belongings with new ones.
B. Reserving the shelf for shared items.
C. Dividing the shelf into two private sections.
D. Removing the shelf to make more floor space.
boss.explain: keep ... for things we both use 指保留作共同用途。

boss.desc: 【語意】The new layout makes better use of the available space. What is claimed?
options: A. The room now contains more space than any other room.
B. The furniture has been removed rather than rearranged.
C. The existing space is used more effectively.
D. The total floor area has been physically enlarged.
boss.explain: 更有效使用原空間，不必代表擴建或家具全移除。

boss.desc: 【短文】A resident labels a chair unused because nobody sat in it during his visit. Another resident says it is used on other evenings. What was the first resident assuming?
options: A. A chair must be occupied continuously to remain safe.
B. The other resident was responsible for buying the chair.
C. The visit had taken place on the same evening every week.
D. A short observation represented the chair’s usual use.
boss.explain: 單次未用被當成通常未用，觀察範圍不足。

boss.desc: 請唸出：實際可行的安排
boss.speak: a practical arrangement

boss.desc: 請唸出：地板面積未增但房間感覺更大
boss.ans: THE ROOM FEELS LARGER WITHOUT ANY EXTRA FLOOR SPACE
boss.speak: the room feels larger without any extra floor space
boss.vocabId: R6:THE ROOM FEELS LARGER WITHOUT ANY EXTRA FLOOR SPACE

boss.desc: 請拼出：改變物品原有排列位置（R 開頭，9 個字母）
boss.speak: rearrange

boss.desc: 填空題：S O _ N D _ R _ O F (能阻隔聲音傳入或傳出的)
boss.speak: soundproof

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: keep someone posted
options: A. 把某人的職位永久保留
B. 將同一張公告反覆張貼
C. 隨時告知某人最新進展
D. 要求某人留在郵局
boss.explain: keep posted 指持續提供近況。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: Please count the replies, not the number of people mentioned in each reply; we need both figures separately.
options: A. 每封回覆只代表一人，兩項數字必定相同。
B. 請把回覆提及人數刪掉，只留下郵件數。
C. 回覆數只能由參加者自己統計後提交。
D. 請統計回覆數而非每封提及人數，兩個數字要分開。
boss.explain: 要求分開兩種單位，不是永久忽略其中一項。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: We do not need everyone to stay late, but we do need to know in advance who can.
options: A. 不需要人人留晚，但需事先知道誰可以。
B. 每人都必須留晚，只是可自行決定何時告知。
C. 誰可留晚並不重要，人數足夠就不必記錄。
D. 留晚安排只能等活動結束後才開始詢問。
boss.explain: 全員要求與確定可用人力不同。

boss.desc: 【語用】I can help set up, though I will need to leave before the guests arrive. What is the speaker doing?
options: A. Asking the guests to arrive earlier than planned.
B. Declining to take part in any preparation.
C. Offering limited help with preparation.
D. Accepting responsibility for welcoming every guest.
boss.explain: 同意布置並限定離開時間，非全盤拒絕。

boss.desc: 【語意】The event is informal, but punctuality still matters. Which action best fits?
options: A. Choosing any arrival time because there is no dress code.
B. Waiting outside until someone puts on formal clothes.
C. Arriving after the event because it is not a meeting.
D. Arriving at the stated time in relaxed clothing.
boss.explain: informal 未取消準時要求；服裝較輕鬆與時間明確可並存。

boss.desc: 【短文】An organiser thanks the team for adapting to a late change but says it should not become the normal way of planning. What is distinguished?
options: A. Appreciating flexibility from accepting avoidable disruption as routine.
B. Praising the team from accepting that any change occurred.
C. Welcoming new ideas from allowing team members to speak.
D. Rewarding preparation from requiring people to attend.
boss.explain: 肯定應變不等於認可反覆臨時變動。

boss.desc: 請唸出：交代清楚的工作交接
boss.speak: a clear handover

boss.desc: 請唸出：請把回覆數與出席人數分開
boss.ans: PLEASE KEEP THE REPLY COUNT SEPARATE FROM THE ATTENDANCE COUNT
boss.speak: please keep the reply count separate from the attendance count
boss.vocabId: R6:PLEASE KEEP THE REPLY COUNT SEPARATE FROM THE ATTENDANCE COUNT

boss.desc: 請拼出：活動所需人員物品移動與安排工作（L 開頭，9 個字母）
boss.speak: logistics

boss.desc: 填空題：O V _ R _ I _ H T (因疏忽而遺漏或犯下的錯誤)
boss.speak: oversight

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: It belonged to my aunt before it came to me, though I cannot remember where she got it.
options: A. 我知道阿姨買它的地點，卻不知現在屬於誰。
B. 這一直是我的，阿姨只曾暫時借用。
C. 我記得它曾屬阿姨，但確定不是她交給我的。
D. 這原屬阿姨後來給我，但我不記得她從哪取得。
boss.explain: 交代一段所有權沿革，對更早來源保留未知。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The collection began with one suitcase, and somehow the suitcase now takes up less room than everything we have added since.
options: A. 收藏始於一只行李箱，如今後來新增的東西占空間更多。
B. 所有收藏現在仍能裝進最初那只行李箱。
C. 行李箱因後來縮小，所以看來比藏品小。
D. 說話者決定丟掉新增藏品，只留下行李箱。
boss.explain: 幽默敘述收藏擴增，未說縮小物件或決定丟棄。

boss.desc: 🎧 聽一聽，選出最符合說話者意思的解讀
boss.speak: The letters are moving partly because they were never intended to explain a whole life to strangers.
options: A. 說話者覺得私人信件不應含有任何生活細節。
B. 信件感人，部分因為它們本無意向陌生人解釋整個人生。
C. 信件原本專為陌生人寫完整傳記，所以令人感動。
D. 信件因所有字都會移動而難以閱讀。
boss.explain: moving 在此感人；非公共完整自傳的片段感具有感染力。

boss.desc: 【語用】You are welcome to take photographs, but please leave the flash off. What is permitted?
options: A. Using the flash if no other visitor is nearby.
B. Taking pictures only of the written labels.
C. Borrowing a camera from any nearby visitor.
D. Taking pictures without using the flash.
boss.explain: 明示允許拍照，限制在閃光燈，不加其他條件。

boss.desc: 【文法】The guide showed us a drawer ___ with old tickets and letters.
options: A. filled
B. filling
C. had filled
D. was filling
boss.explain: drawer filled with ... 過去分詞作後置修飾，抽屜被裝滿。

boss.desc: 【短文】A postcard says, We arrived safely, though our luggage has chosen a different holiday. What happened to the luggage?
options: A. It was given to someone who wanted a holiday.
B. It did not arrive with the travellers.
C. It was deliberately sent ahead to the hotel.
D. It contained a second set of holiday tickets.
boss.explain: 擬人化 chosen different holiday 幽默描述行李去了別處。

boss.desc: 請唸出：家族代代相傳的物品
boss.speak: a family heirloom

boss.desc: 請唸出：原件留樓上而遊客觸摸複本
boss.ans: THE ORIGINAL REMAINS UPSTAIRS WHILE VISITORS HANDLE THE COPY
boss.speak: the original remains upstairs while visitors handle the copy
boss.vocabId: R6:THE ORIGINAL REMAINS UPSTAIRS WHILE VISITORS HANDLE THE COPY

boss.desc: 請拼出：因個人情感與回憶而珍重的（S 開頭，11 個字母）
boss.speak: sentimental

boss.desc: 填空題：F _ A _ I _ E (容易破損而需小心處理的)
boss.speak: fragile
